publicHost.label: Public addr.
publicHost.tip: Address the panel writes into client configs instead of the SSH host (needed if the server is reachable from outside on a different address/port, e.g. behind NAT)

hostKey.label: Host key
hostKey.tip: Public key of the SSH host. "Pinned" — the panel verifies it on every connection and will detect a spoof. TOFU (trust-on-first-use) — the key isn't pinned in the DB: trust is held only in memory and resets on almost any action (editing the server, adding/removing a provider, restarting the panel) -- so it's not "trust once", it's "trust again every time". A host spoof (MITM) can't be detected. To pin it: run ssh-keyscan against the host over a trusted channel and paste the public key into the field below.

providers.label: Providers
providers.tip: How many providers are registered on this node and how many of them are actually up on the host right now

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.tip: Disabling drops the panel's connection to this node but keeps every provider setting -- re-enable any time with no loss of config. Deleting erases everything permanently.

actions.providersTitle: List of VPN providers installed on this node
actions.deleteTitle: Delete node and all provider settings
actions.deleteConfirmDetail: Every provider, its settings, client secrets, and history for this node will be permanently deleted. To just disconnect the node without losing settings, use the "Enabled" toggle instead.
actions.disableConfirm: Disable node {{id}}? Providers stay configured, but the connection will be dropped.

host.label: SSH host
host.tip: The panel connects here over SSH to manage VPN — this is the address of the physical/virtual host, not an address inside a container. If VPN is deployed on the SAME machine where the panel itself runs (Docker): don't specify 127.0.0.1/localhost — that would mean "inside the panel's container", not the host. Specify the real LAN IP of the host machine (sshd must listen on it), or on Linux add extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"] to docker-compose and specify host.docker.internal.

hostKey.label: Pinned host key
hostKey.probeWarning: The panel just connected and looked at whatever key the host is presenting right now -- this is NOT an authenticity check (exactly as exposed to spoofing as a plain ssh-keyscan). Before pinning it, verify the fingerprint through an independent channel -- e.g. your hosting provider's console or direct console access to the server.
hostKey.pinned: Key filled in -- don't forget to save the server

serviceUser.tip: The account the panel will use going forward. If it doesn't exist on the host yet, the script creates it (key-only, no password). If it already exists, it's just granted rights -- never re-created.

bootstrap.keyLabel: That account's private key — used once, not stored
bootstrap.keyAuthSudoWarning: Key auth for a sudo user requires passwordless sudo (NOPASSWD) already configured for it -- there's nowhere to type a password. If that's not the case, use a password instead of a key, or connect as root.

form.sshKey: Private SSH key for the panel's account -- it must already be fully set up on the host (no automatic setup)
